comment: The class of each tool of ordered-json that make rebuild-check checks (S1). The copies of kit under scripts/kit are not listed: kit classifies them.

scripts/external-inputs.mts.reason: mise installs a pinned url with a sha256 through its http backend, as mise.toml does for composer.phar; item T2.7 moves the PIE PHAR and the JSONTestSuite revision to it and removes this installer

scripts/present.mts.reason: present of kit (K156) is not exported by @polyspec/kit, and no ecosystem library asserts a defined value and returns it typed; reported to the conductor as a missing export of kit

scripts/records.mts.reason: the verification records of polyspec name the sources that a run checked with their sha256, a rule of this repository with no ecosystem equivalent; node:crypto hashes

scripts/registry.mts.reason: the commands of the shared verifier for the implementations of config/parity.json, the product of this repository; no ecosystem tool builds and probes four languages

scripts/verify.mts.reason: the shared verifier compares every implementation with the golden results of the JSON contract, the product of this repository; node:util parseArgs reads its arguments
